document.ui:
<Dashboard id="monitor"><Surface id="main"><Scroll id="scroll"><Column id="overview" gap="24dp">
<Column id="health" gap="4dp"><Status id="status" text={state.status} tone={state.statusTone}/><Text id="updated" text={state.updated} variant="caption" tone="muted"/></Column>
<Width id="metricswide" min="640dp"><Grid id="metricsGridwide" columns={2} gap="16dp"><Use id="cpuwide" definition="homelab-metric-card" params={state.cpu}/><Use id="memorywide" definition="homelab-metric-card" params={state.memory}/></Grid></Width>
<Width id="metricsnarrow" max="640dp"><Grid id="metricsGridnarrow" columns={1} gap="16dp"><Use id="cpunarrow" definition="homelab-metric-card" params={state.cpu}/><Use id="memorynarrow" definition="homelab-metric-card" params={state.memory}/></Grid></Width>
<Column id="storage" gap="12dp"><Text id="storageHeading" text="Storage" variant="heading"/><Text id="storageNote" text="Available disk space" variant="caption" tone="muted"/>
<Width id="storagewide" min="800dp"><For id="diskswide" items={state.disks} key={item.id} columns={3} gap="12dp"><Column id="diskwide" surface="card" padding="16dp" gap="4dp"><Text id="mountwide" text={item.mount}/><Text id="freewide" text={item.value} variant="metric" tone={item.tone}/><Text id="devicewide" text={item.device} variant="caption" tone="muted"/></Column></For></Width>
<Width id="storagemedium" min="480dp" max="800dp"><For id="disksmedium" items={state.disks} key={item.id} columns={2} gap="12dp"><Column id="diskmedium" surface="card" padding="16dp" gap="4dp"><Text id="mountmedium" text={item.mount}/><Text id="freemedium" text={item.value} variant="metric" tone={item.tone}/><Text id="devicemedium" text={item.device} variant="caption" tone="muted"/></Column></For></Width>
<Width id="storagenarrow" max="480dp"><For id="disksnarrow" items={state.disks} key={item.id} columns={1} gap="12dp"><Column id="disknarrow" surface="card" padding="16dp" gap="4dp"><Text id="mountnarrow" text={item.mount}/><Text id="freenarrow" text={item.value} variant="metric" tone={item.tone}/><Text id="devicenarrow" text={item.device} variant="caption" tone="muted"/></Column></For></Width>
</Column><Column id="services" gap="12dp"><Text id="servicesHeading" text="Services" variant="heading"/><Text id="servicesSummary" text={state.summary} tone="muted"/>
<Width id="serviceswide" min="1100dp"><For id="targetswide" items={state.targets} key={item.id} columns={4} gap="12dp"><Column id="targetwide" surface="card" padding="16dp" gap="4dp"><Text id="namewide" text={item.name}/><Text id="statuswide" text={item.status} tone={item.tone} variant="caption"/><Text id="endpointwide" text={item.endpoint} tone="muted" variant="caption"/></Column></For></Width>
<Width id="servicesmedium" min="720dp" max="1100dp"><For id="targetsmedium" items={state.targets} key={item.id} columns={3} gap="12dp"><Column id="targetmedium" surface="card" padding="16dp" gap="4dp"><Text id="namemedium" text={item.name}/><Text id="statusmedium" text={item.status} tone={item.tone} variant="caption"/><Text id="endpointmedium" text={item.endpoint} tone="muted" variant="caption"/></Column></For></Width>
<Width id="servicessmall" min="440dp" max="720dp"><For id="targetssmall" items={state.targets} key={item.id} columns={2} gap="12dp"><Column id="targetsmall" surface="card" padding="16dp" gap="4dp"><Text id="namesmall" text={item.name}/><Text id="statussmall" text={item.status} tone={item.tone} variant="caption"/><Text id="endpointsmall" text={item.endpoint} tone="muted" variant="caption"/></Column></For></Width>
<Width id="servicesnarrow" max="440dp"><For id="targetsnarrow" items={state.targets} key={item.id} columns={1} gap="12dp"><Column id="targetnarrow" surface="card" padding="16dp" gap="4dp"><Text id="namenarrow" text={item.name}/><Text id="statusnarrow" text={item.status} tone={item.tone} variant="caption"/><Text id="endpointnarrow" text={item.endpoint} tone="muted" variant="caption"/></Column></For></Width>
<Text id="scope" text="Scrape reachability, not a full application health check." variant="caption" tone="muted"/></Column></Column></Scroll></Surface></Dashboard>

document.source:
<Column id="card" surface="card" gap="8dp" padding="20dp">
  <Text id="label" text={params.label} tone="muted"/>
  <Text id="value" text={params.value} variant="metric" tone={params.tone}/>
  <Chart id="trend" values={params.history} label="Past hour · 5-minute samples" height="100dp"/>
</Column>
